views.text: In July 2026, Equity Mates described Chewy as an online pet retailer with a $10.8 billion market cap, calling it the Amazon of pet retail, and said it had expanded into vet clinics and prescription pet medication.

views.text: In July 2026, Equity Mates said Chewy faced competition from Amazon, which already sold pet products and could pressure it with scale and distribution, while noting a counterpoint that pure play retailers tended to capture more top-end spend.
